label: GTR GRID/DIA trust system
description: TSMM graph instance for a GTR-style flow where GRID discovery and DIA verification produce a relying-party trust decision and operational effect.

nodes.label: GTR GRID/DIA ecosystem
nodes.description: Trust domain for global registrar discovery and Digital Identity Anchor verification.

nodes.label: GRID governance authority
nodes.description: Governing body or administering authority that defines eligibility criteria, standards, and approval pathways.

nodes.label: Global Registrar Information Directory
nodes.description: Curated discovery layer for registrar metadata, verification material, and lifecycle state.

nodes.label: GRID harvester and publication service
nodes.description: Technical service that validates, harvests, publishes, and archives GRID records.

nodes.label: Authoritative Registrar X
nodes.description: Registrar with bounded legal authority for a specific jurisdiction and register type.

nodes.label: Registered Entity Y
nodes.description: Entity represented by a registrar-issued Digital Identity Anchor.

nodes.label: Digital Identity Anchor for Entity Y
nodes.description: DIA carrying legal identity assertions and subject DID binding.

nodes.label: GRID eligibility and scope policy
nodes.description: Policy defining registrar admission, scope, lifecycle, and evidence requirements.

nodes.label: GRID release and registrar evidence bundle
nodes.description: Versioned GRID record, registrar mandate evidence, issuer key status, and freshness metadata.

nodes.label: Supply-chain onboarding platform
nodes.description: Relying party evaluating whether the DIA is sufficient for supplier onboarding.

nodes.label: Platform verifier
nodes.description: Verification component that checks DIA signature, GRID discovery, authority scope, and status.

nodes.label: DIA verification trust decision
nodes.description: Decision produced by applying policy and evidence to the DIA verification request.

nodes.label: Allow low-risk supplier onboarding
nodes.description: Operational effect admitted after successful verification.

edges.description: Governance authority defines eligibility, scope, and lifecycle rules.
Governance authority constrains the directory service and publication process.
Technical operator runs harvesting, validation, release, and archive functions.
Registrar is authorized only within declared legal mandate and register scope.
GRID lists registrar metadata, verification material, and status.
Registrar issues DIA for the registered entity.
DIA asserts registration and DID binding claims about the subject.
Evidence bundle substantiates authority, key, lifecycle, and freshness state.
Verifier checks DIA signature, GRID discovery, status, scope, and revocation state.
Evidence bundle informs the relying-party trust decision.
Relying party consumes the decision rather than the credential alone.
Decision admits the bounded onboarding effect.
